decisions.reason: As a flagship extension of the firm's established biodynamic yogurt range, it fits strongly with existing know-how and supplier relationships, and its continued presence through 2024 suggests the firm can learn from market feedback and refine it rather than withdraw it.

This mild sliced cheese is very close to the firm's core dairy and cheesemaking capabilities, so absorptive capacity is high and the firm is likely to improve distribution or positioning before considering delisting.

Sliced butter cheese also builds directly on the firm's established cheese expertise and production base, and with in-house R&D in a growing market the likely management choice is to keep it and optimize it rather than remove it quickly.
